# Flow & Automation Catalog

One owner per automated process (see docs/STA.md §4). Record-triggered, scheduled and screen flows, the approval process and Apex triggers.

## Flows

| Flow | Trigger | Object | Status | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EH_Account_Lifecycle_From_Subscription` | RecordAfterSave CreateAndUpdate | Billing_Subscription__c | Active | Only automation that writes Account.Lifecycle_Stage__c (STA §4). Active subscription -> Customer; last active subscription cancelled/expired -> Former Customer. |
| `EH_Amend_Renew_Subscription` | Screen | - | Active | Q2C-07: starts an Amendment or Renewal from a subscription. UI only: SubscriptionChangeService builds the opportunity and quote pre-filled with the current recurring charges. |
| `EH_Integration_Retry` | Screen | - | Active | Operator retry for a failed billing sync (STA §3.4). UI only: BillingSyncService.retry owns the logic and checks the EH_Retry_Integration custom permission server-side, so non-operators land on the error screen. |
| `EH_Quote_Before_Save` | RecordBeforeSave Create | Quote | Active | Only owner of Quote_Type__c defaulting (STA §4). Before-save on create: Opportunity record type New Business -> New, Amendment -> Amend, Renewal -> Renew. |
| `EH_Renewal_Generator` | Scheduled Daily 04:00 org time | Billing_Subscription__c | Active | Only owner of renewal Opportunity creation (STA §4). Daily: for each Active subscription without a renewal, within Q2C_Setting__mdt.Default.Renewal_Lead_Days__c of term end, create one Renewal Opportunity and link it. Idempotent: entry filter excludes linked subscriptions; Opportunity.Renewal_Key__c is unique as a backstop. |

## Approval processes

| Approval process | Object | Active | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Quote.EH_Quote_Discount_Approval` | Quote | true | Q2C-04: quotes whose max line discount exceeds the CMDT threshold need manager approval before they can be accepted. The threshold is enforced by VR Approval_Required_Before_Accept (approval entry criteria can't read Custom Metadata), so entry is open to any non-accepted quote. |
